messages:
incident-bot: autopage fired -> METRICS:prom_scrape_down (scale:90%) + LOGINGEST:logbuffer_backpressure (kafka lag rising). page to eng-sre-oncall (rotation: ops-rotation). details: affected: prometheus-exporter-*/metrics (5xx), log-ingest-consumer lag ~60k, some customers reporting missing dashboards :warning:

maya: acked. jumping in. any customer impact yet?

alex: seeing scrape errors from node-exporter on cluster-us-west-2. 503s from exporter pod, logs show OOMKilled yesterday then restarted, now returning 503s consistently.

maya: confirmed dashboards missing for a subset of infra metrics (cpu, disk). alert spike correlates with exporter 503s and consumer lag.

incident-bot: pd: Incident (P2) created -> PD-2319, owner: ops-rotation. Escalation policy: metrics-ingest-team.

taylor: I'm on kafka consumers. consumer-groups show consumer group "log-ingest-prod" lag growth on topic logs-prod-raw. running: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --describe --group log-ingest-prod`

sanjay: quick check - are we seeing an autoscaler failing to spin up more ingestion pods? HPA/VPAs?

alex: HPA is at target, nodes are saturated. kube-scheduler reporting pending pods due to node allocatable pressure. `kubectl get pods -o wide` shows several pending because of CPU.

maya: ok, immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale up node pool temporarily (+3 m5g.4x) 2) restart prometheus-exporter pods after checking init logs 3) increase log-ingest consumer parallelism to drain backlog 4) mute noisy alerts once we have a clear impact window. agree?

taylor: +1 for scale-up. I'll trigger an emergency node pool scale (GCP console) and open a cluster resize runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/cluster-scale

sanjay: I'll prod the autoscaler logs. also suggest flipping the log-ingest consumer to fallback mode to process from earliest uncommitted offsets faster: `consumer-cli --group log-ingest-prod --parallel 12 --commit-interval 500`

ops-rotation: handoff note: I'm primary until 1755554600 UTC. marking PD-2319 and adding customer-ops-bot to notify customers if we exceed 30m degraded metrics.

maya: restarting exporter to see if it returns stable. cc @alex -- grabbing pod logs first: ```
kubectl logs prometheus-exporter-7f8d9 -n observability --previous
# shows repeated OOM followed by segfault in telemetry handler
```

alex: there are large scrape response sizes for a few endpoints — looks like a memory leak in exporter after recent change. rolling back to v1.2.4 (last stable) now: `kubectl set image deployment/prometheus-exporter=registry/rex/prometheus-exporter:v1.2.4 -n observability`

incident-bot: update -> PD-2319 status: acknowledged by maya, assigned to ops-rotation.

taylor: node pool scale requested, GCP accepted. new nodes provisioning (eta ~4min).

sanjay: autoscaler logs show a throttling error talking to cloud API — we may be hitting a quota. emailing infra-aws-team and opening infra ticket INFRA-889. in parallel, I'll kick manual node add via console.

maya: log-ingest consumers bumped to 12, parallelism increased. consumer lag decreased from 60k -> 28k in 2 minutes. good.

ops-rotation: customer-ops-bot: notify customers? we are at 12m degraded for a subset of infra metrics, not product metrics.

customer-ops-bot: automated-notify queued -> Customers with dashboards subscribed: 18 tenants. message drafted: "We are experiencing delayed infra metrics for dashboards in us-west-2. No product request or data loss detected. Engineers are actively mitigating. ETA ~30m." send? :email:

maya: send it. keep wording cautious.

alex: exporter rollback completed. new exporter pods come up healthy. initial scrape success rate rising (from ~40% -> ~92%).

taylor: nodes are ready, new node pool members joined. pending pods scheduling cleared.

sanjay: kafka lag continuing to fall, now at 6k. consumer throughput up ~2.8x.

maya: thanks team. next steps: keep monitoring for 30m, don't close PD until logs fully drained and exporters stable for 1h. assign postmortem owner?

ops-rotation: assigning postmortem to alex. PD-2319 -> postmortem ticket PM-1022. include remediation: exporter memory cap, add OOM alerts, add canary rollout for exporter image, increase node pool quota buffer.

alex: got it. I'll draft postmortem. quick check — any customers impacted by missing billing metrics or quota evaluation?

customer-ops-bot: scan: no billing-related metrics missing. only infra dashboards. no alerting for customer SLAs triggered.

maya: taking runbook actions to mute redundant alerts: `alertmanager silence add prometheus_exporter_down --duration=35m` to avoid noise during drain.

incident-bot: PD-2319 update -> resolved for customer-facing metrics at 1755554345. full resolution pending until logs drained.

taylor: tailing consumer metrics: throughput steady, lag trending to zero.

sanjay: infra ticket INFRA-889 updated: quota increase requested for node pool.

ops-rotation: final customer note queued for 1755554600 UTC: "Metrics ingestion degraded for ~25 minutes, now recovering. No data loss detected. We rolled back an exporter image and scaled nodes to mitigate. Full postmortem forthcoming."

maya: thanks. closing on-call thread, keeping PD open until PM-1022 is linked and validation completed. :white_check_mark:

alex: adding recommended follow-ups in PM-1022: automated canary checks for exporter memory, add mem cap, add targeted integration test to emit large scrape payloads, and verify HPA node quota slack.

incident-bot: PD-2319 status -> monitoring. thread archived in 24h unless reopened.
